describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with the overall body shape, dense shaggy fur, head, limbs and paws of a bear combined with several glossy, hard, dark reddish-brown structures resembling a beetle. It stands on four thick, furry legs with a short stubby tail at the rear and a bear-like head at the front bearing a single large curved black horn on the forehead. Most of the body is covered in long brown fur that is darker on the legs and lighter on the muzzle and along the mid-side, while the mid-back, shoulder-chest, and outer hindquarter are covered by smooth, shiny, ridged plates, the lower legs are encircled by narrow segmented bands, and two horizontal rows of small oval holes run along the side of the torso.

describe.description: The creature is a bulky four-legged mammal with the overall shape, dense brown fur, head, legs, clawed paws and short stub tail of a brown bear, shown in side view facing right.
